question: Which three exact cuisine labels had the highest 2025 Delivered-order GMV in INR? For each label, also give total order count and cancellation rate. Do not split comma-separated cuisine labels.

action.query: SELECT CUISINE, SUM(DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, COUNT_IF(IS_CANCELLED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS CANCELLATION_RATE FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND CURRENCY = 'INR' AND CUISINE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUISINE ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC, CUISINE ASC LIMIT 3
action.metrics: Delivered GMV in INR; total order count; cancellation rate (cancelled orders / all orders)
action.group_by: Exact CUISINE value; comma-separated labels remain intact

action.answer: For orders recorded from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 with currency INR, ranked by delivered GMV (sum of DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT), the top three exact cuisine labels are: 1) “North Indian,Chinese” — delivered GMV INR 97,195,380.00; 202,651 total orders; cancellation rate 5.880060% (cancelled orders / all orders). 2) “Indian,Chinese” — delivered GMV INR 60,447,386.00; 126,766 total orders; cancellation rate 5.981888%. 3) “Indian” — delivered GMV INR 58,362,786.00; 148,932 total orders; cancellation rate 6.000054%. Comma-separated cuisine labels were kept intact.
